newsitem.title: USA: Clinton making Christmas visit to Marines.
newsitem.headline: Clinton making Christmas visit to Marines.

text.p: President Clinton will make a Christmas season visit to U.S. Marines and their families at Camp Lejeune, N.C., on Dec. 23, the White House said Wednesday.
White House spokesman Mike McCurry said Clinton would meet with a unit that recently returned from a six-month deployment to the Mediterranean Sea.
"The visit celebrates the holiday season, highlights the contributions and sacrifices made by America's armed forces and their families," McCurry told reporters.
Clinton has made annual visits to military facilities during the Christmas season to greet service personnel.
